Harry Potter 2: Chamber of Secrets – The Serpent King: Basilisk!

by iEtsh

Story

Deep beneath Hogwarts lies the Chamber of Secrets, a hidden chamber built by Salazar Slytherin, one of the four founders of Hogwarts. Within it dwells an ancient and deadly creature: the Basilisk, the King of Serpents.

Ginny Weasley has fallen unconscious on the cold stone floor of the Chamber, her life slowly fading as Tom Riddle drains her strength through his enchanted diary. Under his command, the Basilisk slithers through the dark network of pipes beneath Hogwarts, hunting for its next victim...

RULES

Sudoku Rules

Standard Sudoku: Place the digits 1–9 in every row, column, and 3×3 box without repetition.

♞

Anti-Knight

Cells that are a chess knight's move apart cannot contain the same digit.

🐍

Basilisk Pipes

The Basilisk enters the pipe system through the first pipe opening at R5C1 and follows a single continuous, closed path through the pipes and underground sewers.

The sewer connections are as follows:

• R1C5 is connected to R9C5.

• R5C9 is connected to R1C1.

• R4C1 is connected to R9C9.

• R6C9 is connected back to R5C1, completing the loop.

Whenever the Basilisk reaches a sewer entrance, it leaves the grid entirely and travels through the underground sewers before re-entering the pipe system through the specified opening. All pipe and sewer sections form one continuous closed loop.

▲▼

Peaks and Valleys

Every three consecutive cells along the Basilisk's pipe path must contain either two Peaks and one Valley, or one Peak and two Valleys. These two patterns must alternate throughout the path.

A Peak is a cell whose digit is greater than the digits in both adjacent cells along the path.

A Valley is a cell whose digit is smaller than the digits in both adjacent cells along the path.
